headline: Sold too early, regret; held on, relief! 00991A surged 8.17% over three days in Q4, beating the broad market by two times
summary: Taiwan stocks surged 1,236 points on heavy trading volume on the 5th, closing at 49,712 points, with trading value rising sharply.
why: Taiwan's stock market is heavily weighted toward semiconductor and electronics companies, so its moves reflect the global tech and AI cycle.
why_moved: The input reports the surge on heavy trading volume but does not state a specific cause.
